newsitem.title: USA: EDITEK postpones vote on more stock.
newsitem.headline: EDITEK postpones vote on more stock.

text.p: EDITEK Inc said Tuesday it has postponed its annual meeting scheduled for November 6, where shareholders were to vote on a proposal doubling the number of authorized common shares to 60 million.
The company said it has not set a new date for the meeting.

EDITEK explained it has entered into negotiations with holders of its Series A Preferred who sued the company in August. Shortly after the suits were filed, the company said they "allege breech of contract with respect to conversion" of that stock to common.
Spokesman Peter Heath explained Tuesday the company does not have enough authorized common to convert the preferred.
"It would be inappropriate to comment on the specifics of negotiations at this time. Accordingly, the company has postponed the annual meeting," EDITEK's statement said.

It said the company "communicated a proposal to all preferred shareholders in order to find a mutually acceptable solution to resolve the company's inability to issue shares to the preferred shareholders," but provided no further details.
